title: Dismantling Hubble’s Legacy?
lineage: Inspected provider-rendered passages or catalog as specified; local file is attributed research notes, not a copy of the source.

passages.note: Discussion of Hubble 1929: the fit used Slipher-derived radial velocities in large part, and quoted about 465 ± 50 km/s/Mpc for 24 individual objects and 513 ± 60 for 9 groups. Robertson and Lemaître produced earlier related work.
